_meta.note: Indian pavilions abroad are run by Export Promotion Councils (EEPC, ESC, IEEMA, ACMA, Plastindia, FIEO, TEPC, Pharmexcil, ELCINA), ITPO, NASSCOM and Startup India / MeitY. Stalls inside a pavilion cost a fraction of a direct booking and carry MAI / IC subsidy. Priority 1 = apply this month; 5 = parked. Dates marked 'to verify' are re-checked by the 3-day routine.
_meta.how_to_apply: 1) Join the EPC (ESC India for software/AI: escindia.in; EEPC for engineering) — 12 months' membership unlocks MAI airfare reimbursement. 2) Watch the EPC circular for each fair (usually 4–6 months before). 3) Apply with the space form + 50% advance from the current account; keep invoices for the MAI/IC claim within 30 days after.
